# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| refactor/v0.2 (current) | ✅ |
| older branches | ❌ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in BBXDOO, please **do not** open a public issue.

Instead, report it privately by emailing the project maintainers or using GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) feature.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Potential impact assessment
- Any suggested mitigations (optional)

We will acknowledge receipt within **5 business days** and aim to provide a resolution timeline within **14 business days**.

## Disclosure Policy

We follow a coordinated disclosure model. Please allow us adequate time to address the issue before any public disclosure.
